Used by the existing signed content contract. No API, approval writer, scoring

from decimal import Decimal,InvalidOperation
import hashlib
import json
import re

VERSION='PH-SAQ-PENDING-MARKING-DELIVERY-1'
PURPOSE='INDEPENDENT_RESPONSE_PENDING_MARKING'
POLICY='OWNER_QA_FIREWALL_AVAILABILITY_PENDING_MARKING_20261122_1'
PROOF='CURRENT_NATIVE_SOURCE_QA_FIREWALL_AVAILABILITY_1'
HASHES=('material_checksum_sha256','source_workbook_sha256','source_row_sha256',
        'truth_source_sha256','rubric_contract_sha256','source_snapshot_sha256',
        'source_academic_evidence_sha256','learner_content_sha256')
DESTINATION=('market_id','programme_id','subject_id','chapter_id',
             'release_profile_id','release_profile_checksum_sha256')

def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),
        ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()

def hashed(value):return isinstance(value,str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',value) is not None
def text(value):return isinstance(value,str) and bool(value.strip())
def number(value):
    if isinstance(value,bool):raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_FINITE_MARKS_REQUIRED')
    try:out=Decimal(str(value))
    except (InvalidOperation,ValueError,TypeError):raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_FINITE_MARKS_REQUIRED') from None
    if not out.is_finite():raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_FINITE_MARKS_REQUIRED')
    return out

            or contract.get('official_ai_scoring_enabled') is not False
            or 'academic_approval' in contract or 'assessment_approval' in contract
            or contract.get('contract_sha256')!=digest({k:v for k,v in contract.items() if k!='contract_sha256'})):
        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_DELIVERY_CONTRACT_INVALID')
    if (type(contract.get('native_question_id')) is not int or contract['native_question_id']<=0
            or not text(contract.get('question_id')) or not text(contract.get('source_question_id'))
            or type(contract.get('independent_mastery_weight')) is not int
            or contract['independent_mastery_weight']!=1

        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_SOURCE_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    maximum=number(contract.get('maximum_marks'))
    if (not isinstance(rubric,dict) or rubric.get('version')!='PH-SAQ-SCORING-CONTRACT-1'

            or rubric.get('source_marking_evidence_sha256')!=contract['source_row_sha256']

            or len({p['id'] for p in points})!=len(points)):
        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_SOURCE_MARK_POINTS_INVALID')
    if rubric.get('scoring_type')=='ANY_N_FROM_VALID_SET':
        n=rubric.get('required_count')
        allocations={number(p['marks']) for p in points}

    else:total=sum(number(p['marks']) for p in points)

                'quality_assessment_checksum_sha256','native_review_snapshot_checksum_sha256','source_binding_sha256'))
            or proof.get('proof_sha256')!=digest({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='proof_sha256'})):
        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_CURRENT_QA_FIREWALL_PROOF_REQUIRED')
    fields={'source_workbook_sha256':contract['source_workbook_sha256'],
        'truth_source_sha256':contract['truth_source_sha256'],
        'source_snapshot_sha256':contract['source_snapshot_sha256'],
        'academic_evidence_sha256':contract['source_academic_evidence_sha256'],
        'source_question_id':contract['source_question_id']}

        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_QA_SOURCE_BINDING_CONFLICT')
    dest=contract.get('destination')
    if not isinstance(dest,dict) or set(dest)!=set(DESTINATION) or any(not text(dest[k]) for k in DESTINATION) or not hashed(dest['release_profile_checksum_sha256']):
        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_DESTINATION_INVALID')

            or output.get('response_type')!='TEXT'
            or output.get('source_response_mode') not in {'FREE_TEXT_CONSTRUCTED_RESPONSE','FREE_RESPONSE_SHORT',
                'FREE_TEXT_SHORT','SHORT_CONSTRUCTED_RESPONSE','FREE_TEXT_SHORT_CONSTRUCTED_RESPONSE',
                'SHORT_CONSTRUCTED_TEXT','SHORT_FREE_RESPONSE','CONSTRUCTED_SHORT_TEXT'}
            or output.get('source_output_type') not in {'PLAIN_TEXT','TEXT','TEXT_SHORT_RESPONSE',
                'PLAIN_TEXT_SHORT_RESPONSE','SHORT_CONSTRUCTED_TEXT','SYMBOLIC_OR_SHORT_TEXT',
                'NUMERICAL_WITH_SHORT_JUSTIFICATION','NUMERICAL_WITH_WORKING'}
            or output.get('required_produced_representation') not in {
                'NONE','N/A','NOT_REQUIRED','TEXTUAL_SEQUENCE_OR_SYMBOLIC_RESPONSE'}):
        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_PHYSICAL_OUTPUT_UNSUPPORTED')
    scope=contract.get('mastery_scope') or {}
    ranks={'FOUNDATION':0,'EXAM_READY':1,'ADVANCED':2,'DISTINCTION':3}
    if (set(scope)!={'mastery_level','assessment_ceiling'}
            or scope.get('mastery_level') not in ranks or scope.get('assessment_ceiling') not in ranks
            or ranks[scope['mastery_level']]>ranks[scope['assessment_ceiling']]):
        raise ValueError('PENDING_SAQ_SOURCE_MASTERY_SCOPE_CONFLICT')
    if question is not None:
        q=dict(question)
        if (q.get('ph_question_id')!=contract['question_id'] or not text(q.get('ph_question_version_id'))
                or not hashed(q.get('ph_question_checksum_sha256'))
                or number(q.get('ph_independent_mastery_weight'))!=1
                or q.get('ph_evidence_role')!='INDEPENDENT'
                or q.get('ph_dependency_type') in {'DEPENDENT','VARIANT','TRUE_VARIANT','SCAFFOLD',
                    'RECOVERY','RECONFIRMATION','SHARED_STIMULUS_DEPENDENT'}

        if isinstance(provenance,str):provenance=json.loads(provenance)

        for target in item.get('delivery_targets',[]):
            release=(target['release_id'],target['release_version'])
            scope=tuple(target[k] for k in ('package_checksum_sha256','market_id','programme_id','subject_id','chapter_id'))
            if release in releases and releases[release]!=scope:
                raise ValueError('WITHDRAWAL_TARGET_SCOPE_CONTRADICTION')
            releases[release]=scope
            version=(item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'])
            if version in versions and versions[version]!=target['question_checksum_sha256']:
                raise ValueError('WITHDRAWAL_TARGET_VERSION_CONTRADICTION')
            versions[version]=target['question_checksum_sha256']


def ledger_record(envelope):
    return {'schema_version':envelope['schema_version'],'payload':envelope['payload']}


def migrate_existing_ledger(c):
    columns={row[1] for row in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(ph_bridge_withdrawal_receipts_v6611d)')}
    if 'payload_json' not in columns:
        if c.in_transaction:
            raise RuntimeError('WITHDRAWAL_LEDGER_MIGRATION_REQUIRES_IDLE_CONNECTION')
        c.execute("ALTER TABLE ph_bridge_withdrawal_receipts_v6611d ADD COLUMN payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
    c.execute('''CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ph_withdrawal_payload_immutable_20261122
      BEFORE UPDATE OF payload_json ON ph_bridge_withdrawal_receipts_v6611d
      WHEN OLD.payload_json IS NOT NEW.payload_json
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_WITHDRAWAL_PAYLOAD'); END''')
    c.execute('''CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ph_withdrawal_exclusion_immutable_update_20261122
      BEFORE UPDATE ON ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_WITHDRAWAL_TARGET'); END''')
    c.execute('''CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ph_withdrawal_exclusion_immutable_delete_20261122
      BEFORE DELETE ON ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_WITHDRAWAL_TARGET'); END''')


def _legacy_keys(version):
    keys={str(version['question_version_id']),str(version['question_checksum_sha256'])}
    keys.update(hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest() for value in tuple(keys))
    # Native PH legacy defect fingerprint is a different hash domain. Only
    # literal immutable values and explicit original-family provenance are used.
    content=json.loads(version['content_json']);provenance=json.loads(version['provenance_json'])
    marking=content.get('marking') or {};lineage=provenance.get('lineage') or {}
    family=content.get('question_family_type')
    originals={value.get('native_family') for key,value in lineage.items()
               if key in {'source_saq_wire_projection','source_saq_marking_projection','scoped_practice_wire_projection'}
               and isinstance(value,dict) and value.get('native_family')}
    if len(originals)==1:family=next(iter(originals))
    if len(originals)>1:return keys
    if all(name in marking for name in ('key','explanation')) and 'stem' in content and family:
        keys.add(digest({'public_id':version['question_id'],'stem':content['stem'],
                        'correct_answer':marking['key'],'explanation':marking['explanation'],
                        'question_format':family}))
    return keys


def legacy_targets(c,item):
    fingerprint=str(item.get('question_version_fingerprint') or '')
    if not fingerprint:return None
    versions=c.execute('SELECT * FROM integration_ph_question_version_store WHERE question_id=?',
                       (item['question_public_id'],)).fetchall()
    matches=[]
    for version in versions:
        try:
            if fingerprint in _legacy_keys(version):matches.append(version)
        except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError):return None
    if len(matches)!=1:return None
    version=matches[0]
    placements=c.execute('''SELECT r.* FROM integration_ph_release_question_membership m
      JOIN integration_ph_content_releases r ON r.release_id=m.release_id AND r.release_version=m.release_version
      WHERE m.question_id=? AND m.question_version_id=? AND r.release_operation='PUBLISH_SNAPSHOT'
      AND r.local_status IN ('ACTIVE','STAGED','SUPERSEDED')''',
      (item['question_public_id'],version['question_version_id'])).fetchall()
    # A legacy request cannot choose between independently scoped destinations.
    if len(placements)!=1:return None
    release=placements[0]
    return [{**{key:release[key] for key in TARGET_FIELDS if key in release.keys()},
             'question_version_id':version['question_version_id'],
             'question_checksum_sha256':version['question_checksum_sha256']}]


def _target_conflict(c,item,target,prior):
    release=c.execute('SELECT * FROM integration_ph_content_releases WHERE release_id=? AND release_version=?',
                      (target['release_id'],target['release_version'])).fetchone()
    if release and any(str(release[key])!=str(target[key]) for key in
                       ('package_checksum_sha256','market_id','programme_id','subject_id','chapter_id')):
        return True
    if release and not c.execute('''SELECT 1 FROM integration_ph_release_question_membership
      WHERE release_id=? AND release_version=? AND question_id=? AND question_version_id=?''',
      (target['release_id'],target['release_version'],item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'])).fetchone():
        return True
    key=(target['release_id'],target['release_version'])
    scope=tuple(target[k] for k in ('package_checksum_sha256','market_id','programme_id','subject_id','chapter_id'))
    if key in prior['releases'] and prior['releases'][key]!=scope:return True
    version_key=(item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'])
    if version_key in prior['versions'] and prior['versions'][version_key]!=target['question_checksum_sha256']:return True
    version=c.execute('SELECT question_checksum_sha256 FROM integration_ph_question_version_store '
        'WHERE question_id=? AND question_version_id=?',(item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'])).fetchone()
    if version and version[0]!=target['question_checksum_sha256']:return True
    existing=c.execute('''SELECT question_checksum_sha256 FROM ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e
      WHERE release_id=? AND release_version=? AND question_id=? AND question_version_id=?''',
      (target['release_id'],target['release_version'],item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'])).fetchone()
    return bool(existing and existing[0]!=target['question_checksum_sha256'])


def withdraw_one(c,item,export_id,population,integration,prior=None):
    qid=item['question_public_id']
    targets=item.get('delivery_targets') if 'delivery_targets' in item else legacy_targets(c,item)
    result={'item_public_id':item['item_public_id'],'question_public_id':qid,
            'state':'RETRY','historical_attempts_preserved':True}
    prior=negative_identity_index(c) if prior is None else prior
    if not targets or any(_target_conflict(c,item,target,prior) for target in targets):return result
    active=False
    for target in targets:
        rows=c.execute('''SELECT id FROM questions WHERE ph_projection_owner='POWER_HOUSE'
          AND ph_question_id=? AND ph_question_version_id=? AND ph_question_checksum_sha256=? AND active=1''',
          (qid,target['question_version_id'],target['question_checksum_sha256'])).fetchall()
        ids=[row['id'] for row in rows];active=active or bool(ids)
        c.execute('''INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e(
          release_id,release_version,question_id,question_version_id,question_checksum_sha256,item_public_id,
          export_public_id,population_sha256,withdrawal_queue_id,hold_id,defect_code,reason,item_sha256,created_at)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''',
          (target['release_id'],target['release_version'],qid,target['question_version_id'],
           target['question_checksum_sha256'],item['item_public_id'],export_id,population,
           str(item['withdrawal_queue_id']),str(item['hold_id']),item['defect_code'],item['reason'],
           item['item_sha256'],integration.utcnow()))
        if ids:
            marks=','.join('?' for _ in ids)
            c.execute("UPDATE questions SET active=0,status='Withdrawn' WHERE id IN ("+marks+')',ids)
            integration._preserve_other_active_memberships(c,ids)
    result['state']='WITHDRAWN_AND_STAGED_EXCLUDED' if active else 'STAGED_EXCLUDED'
    return result


def _stored_requests(c):
    for row in c.execute("SELECT payload_json FROM ph_bridge_withdrawal_receipts_v6611d WHERE payload_json<>''"):
        record=json.loads(row[0])
        if not isinstance(record,dict) or not isinstance(record.get('payload'),dict):
            raise ValueError('CORRUPT_WITHDRAWAL_LEDGER_PAYLOAD')
        yield record


def eligible_rows(c,rows):
    """Withhold unresolved legacy stops only when this version could match.

    Known exact stops are already excluded by the native membership SQL. This
    pure read also protects a delayed first import whose legacy stop preceded it.
    """
    rows=list(rows)
    if not rows:return rows
    wanted={row['question_id'] for row in rows};legacy={}
    for record in _stored_requests(c):
        if record['schema_version']!='1.0.0':continue
        for item in record['payload']['items']:
            if item['question_public_id'] in wanted:legacy.setdefault(item['question_public_id'],[]).append(item)
    kept=[]
    for row in rows:
        blocked=False
        for item in legacy.get(row['question_id'],[]):
            try:blocked=str(item['question_version_fingerprint']) in _legacy_keys(row)
            except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError):blocked=True
            if blocked:break
        if not blocked:kept.append(row)
    return kept


def negative_identity_index(c):
    """Operation-local index of actual durable stops, never unresolved requests."""
    exclusions={(r['release_id'],r['release_version'],r['question_id'],r['question_version_id'],r['question_checksum_sha256'])
        for r in c.execute('SELECT release_id,release_version,question_id,question_version_id,question_checksum_sha256 FROM ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e')}
    result={'releases':{},'versions':{},'targets':{}}
    for record in _stored_requests(c):
        if record['schema_version']!='1.1.0':continue
        for item in record['payload']['items']:
            for target in item['delivery_targets']:
                key=(target['release_id'],target['release_version'])
                full=key+(item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'],target['question_checksum_sha256'])
                if full not in exclusions:continue
                scope=tuple(target[k] for k in ('package_checksum_sha256','market_id','programme_id','subject_id','chapter_id'))
                if key in result['releases'] and result['releases'][key]!=scope:
                    raise ValueError('CORRUPT_DURABLE_WITHDRAWAL_SCOPE')
                result['releases'][key]=scope
                result['versions'][(item['question_public_id'],target['question_version_id'])]=target['question_checksum_sha256']
                result['targets'].setdefault(key,{})[item['question_public_id']]=(target['question_version_id'],target['question_checksum_sha256'])
    return result


def content_stop_conflicts(c,release,questions):
    """Check actual stops after native writer claim, before immutable imports."""
    index=negative_identity_index(c);key=(release['release_id'],release['release_version'])
    scope=tuple(release[k] for k in ('package_checksum_sha256','market_id','programme_id','subject_id','chapter_id'))
    if key in index['releases'] and index['releases'][key]!=scope:
        return ['WITHDRAWAL_RELEASE_SCOPE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT']
    expected=index['targets'].get(key,{})
    return ['WITHDRAWAL_QUESTION_VERSION_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'] if any(
        q['question_id'] in expected and (q['question_version_id'],q['question_checksum_sha256'])!=expected[q['question_id']]
        for q in questions) else []
